notes.text: The page continues a description of an extended category of graphs whose arrows are generalized graph morphisms, and states that its isomorphisms are the ordinary ones. It then starts the definition of a morphism of generization between MD-graphs, adding the structures displayed in (46) and a bijection (47), before breaking off at the introduction to the conditions. The first shaft in (46) is flat-ended and is retained literally; its displayed sources remain S and S-prime. The five canceled target superscripts do not allow a secure original prime count. The separate light pencil number at lower left reads 38; its authorship is undetermined. This is a reading and collation summary, not a proof verification.
